reporting-org.narrative: Netherlands Advisory Board on Impact Investing

description.narrative: One of the elements of pressure for the financial sector to move more capital towards impact is also the engagement of their constituency: clients of banks and insurers, employees, beneficiaries of pension funds. Raising the awareness of the public on the potential of – and need for – impact investing will help to create a force for good: clients, employees and beneficiaries will be enticed to demand action from their financial service providers. Moving only a small part of the public opinion can be enough to put pressure on boards of financial institutions. Over the past 2 years, we have realised through our engagement with the financial sector how critically important the support of policymakers can be to enable increased allocations towards impact investing. In 2024, after analysing the political landscape and identifying the key sweet spots for Dutch policymakers, we initiated an awareness campaign directed to the Dutch public sector, to increase the understanding of how impact investing could actually support the government’s impact goals. We started engaging via (social) media attention and initiated one-on-one meetings with representatives of political parties.
